about: Hostomel: private houses and new districts

Hostomel is above all a town of private houses: homesteads on a few hundred square metres, new cottage communities and small complexes closer to the road to Kyiv. Many owners here do not renovate but build anew or substantially rebuild an old house.

For Hostomel plots we often do the whole package: [house design](/en/house-design), construction, systems, interior and landscaping. That way the joints between stages — foundation and floors, services and furniture — hold no surprises at the finishing stage.

In a Hostomel house the design starts with the floor plans: where the bedrooms go, where the utility and boiler rooms are, how you walk from the terrace to the kitchen. Single-storey houses with a terrace and a pool, like our House 150, work especially well on small plots. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate houses after purchase, replan old homesteads and update apartments in complexes; with an old house we first check the roof, walls and services. We build aerated-block and brick, [modular](/en/modular-house) and timber-frame houses, with the [house construction cost](/en/house-construction-cost) set out by stage in the contract.

The same salaried team as in Kyiv, at the same rates: renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m²; 12-month warranty on works. More on [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Our site managers include visits to the town in their normal schedule, just as for Kyiv districts, and materials come from Kyiv warehouses. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.

faq: How much does it cost to build a house in Hostomel?

Shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m². For a 150 m² house the base figure is 150 m² × $600 for the shell or 150 m² × $1,100 turnkey; the exact price comes from the estimate.
Do you do interiors for a house built by another contractor?
Yes. Design from $30 per m², renovation from $550 per m²; if CAS carries out the renovation, we keep within ±5% of the estimate.
Is it better to rebuild an old house or build a new one?
It depends on the foundation and walls. After a survey we give an estimate for both options, so you decide with the numbers in hand.
